== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3463]] is assessed at 96% (proved). Robert’s 1837 Ayrshire birth agrees with the same brother in the 1851 family reconstruction, giving a sustained family identity.

Held MyHeritage census-index extract with the named family relationships; underlying census image was not newly inspected.
